candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (DependencyUnavailable) in inventory, which order calls; gateway /v1/checkout fails after ~2s while /readyz stays 200.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs; gateway dependency metric series empty. Redis timeout inferred from inventory spans only.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts causing inventory 503 and order 502, propagating to gateway /v1/checkout 502 at ~2s. Gateway itself is healthy (/readyz 200). Root cause bounded to redis timeout on the inventory dependency path.
